note: Offline study except for the one calibration input, which is a public Yahoo chart download (^NDX daily, 1985-10-01 -> 2000-03-08, via research/vol_shape_v1/fetch_ndx.py; no credentials, no other network use). Every other price/FX/CPI input is an existing committed research file, taken unchanged from the fast-engine tag archive/research/fast-engine-v1-2026-10 (identical bytes to research/band_h2_combo_v1's DATA_MANIFEST.json, minus the files only the instrument stages need: the 21 range_vol_* CSVs are not read by this study). Uses: vol_shape_v1_ndx.csv (the pre-2000 calibration window); stress_robustness_v1_daily.csv (QQQ/SPY/QLD bars) + stress_robustness_v1_dtb3.csv (DTB3) for the main window, the synthetic QLD* leg and the bootstrap pool; after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_cbrt.csv + after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.csv for the TRY conversion and the Yi-UFE indexation (the after-tax stages start no earlier than 2000-03-09); ewma_band_v1_{gspc,tb3ms}.csv + ewma_band_v1_index.csv for the six OOS windows and the G8 pooling markets (^GSPC 1957-1999 + M1-M5). Two further entries are published evidence (not inputs): research/band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json (K's anchor cells compared in --harness) and the engine's own research/fast_engine/PARITY.json (regenerated by the parity run inside --harness).

data/historical/vol_shape_v1_ndx.csv.role: calibration window of the c_p constants (sizing schedule mean match); excluded from every reported statistic

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.role: QQQ/SPY/QLD OHLC+dividend: the main window, the synthetic daily-reset 2x leg, the bootstrap pool

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.role: DTB3: the QLD* financing/expense accrual and the OOS risk-free series

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_usdtry_c.role: CBRT USD/TRY buying rate at each trade date (the after-tax engine)

data/historical/after_tax_tr_v1_yiufe.cs.role: Yi-UFE monthly index: cost indexation, instalment and deflated-bracket scale

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_index.csv.role: OOS windows M1-M5 (^IXIC / ^GSPC / ^N225 / ^GDAXI / ^FTSE) and the G8 pooled bootstrap

data/historical/ewma_band_v1_tb3ms.csv.role: TB3MS: the pre-1954 risk-free series of the OOS windows

research/band_h2_combo_v1/RESULTS.json.role: evidence: K's published anchor cells reproduced by --harness (not an input)
